lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the branchial region, arranged in roughly equidistant horizontal and vertical rows along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high luminance on the dorsal edge, low luminance shadow on the ventral edge).

other_distinctive_markers: A unique vermiculate or labyrinthine pattern of high-luminance pixels is visible in the transitional zone immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit. Multiple secondary biological subjects (remoras) are visible in the ventral water column below the pectoral fin.
